functional.description: The solution uses the Zammad API endpoint 'http://localhost:8080' (or 'http://zammad:8080')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Zammad instance

functional.description: The solution authenticates with Zammad using the required credentials or API token
functional.rationale: Authentication is required for API access

functional.description: The solution uses the correct API operations for Zammad
functional.rationale: Using correct API operations ensures task completion

robustness.description: The solution handles tickets with missing priority fields by defaulting to priority '2' for SLA target lookup.
robustness.rationale: Ensures all tickets can be processed for SLA calculations even when priority data is incomplete, preventing data loss due to missing metadata.

robustness.description: The solution handles CSV write failures by logging the error to stderr but still attempting to print the summary output.
robustness.rationale: Ensures operators receive processing statistics even when file system issues prevent CSV creation, maintaining visibility into the operation.

robustness.description: The solution handles missing or malformed timestamp fields (created_at, closed_at, updated_at, updatedAt) without crashing by skipping affected tickets.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution continues processing valid tickets even when encountering data quality issues, preventing complete failure due to individual malformed records.

robustness.description: The solution logs errors to stderr when encountering missing or malformed timestamp fields.
robustness.rationale: Provides visibility into data quality issues for operators to investigate and address upstream problems.

robustness.description: The solution handles Zammad API failures by returning an empty ticket list and continuing to produce output with zero tickets.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution completes successfully even when the Zammad service is unavailable, maintaining operational continuity and preventing cascading failures.

robustness.description: The solution logs errors to stderr when the Zammad API fails.
robustness.rationale: Provides visibility into service availability issues for operators to investigate and address connectivity or service problems.

robustness.description: The solution handles missing SLA configuration by using default values and continuing with SLA calculations.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution can operate even when configuration is unavailable, preventing complete failure.

robustness.description: The solution logs a warning to stderr when SLA configuration is missing.
robustness.rationale: Alerts operators to the degraded state so they can restore proper configuration.

robustness.description: The solution prints the summary output even when S3 upload fails.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution reports processing results even when storage fails, allowing operators to be aware of the data while investigating storage issues separately.

robustness.description: The solution exits with code 0 even when S3 upload fails.
robustness.rationale: Indicates successful data processing despite storage failure, preventing false alarms in monitoring systems for the core processing logic.

robustness.description: The solution logs errors to stderr when S3 upload fails.
robustness.rationale: Provides visibility into storage issues for operators to investigate and address S3 connectivity or permission problems.

robustness.description: The solution handles both list and nested response formats from the Zammad API when retrieving tickets.
robustness.rationale: Ensures compatibility with different API response structures, preventing failures due to API version changes or configuration differences.

robustness.description: The solution uses UTC timezone for all timestamp parsing and time window calculations.
robustness.rationale: Ensures consistent time-based filtering across different server timezones, preventing incorrect inclusion or exclusion of tickets due to timezone mismatches.
